title: New account
summary: The Nova conta window (MZ, 19 October 2026, bipe-chat/bipe#445): one sheet for every new account on a phone that already has one. A personal or company sign-up takes its invite from the account on screen, so the invite code step never shows.

inviteId.description: id of the invite POST /v1/me/invites made for this sign-up. A cancel before signup-create revokes it.

code.description: The invite code. Never shown and never logged.

currentName.description: Display name of the account on screen, for bipe_account_new_invite_note.

canAddPersonal.description: canAddAccount of account-switcher. false: the personal row is off and shows bipe_account_cap_reached with max_accounts.

canAddCompany.description: true when the account on screen is not a company and, on iOS, App Attest is supported. Android always tries Key Attestation at signup-create (bipe-chat/bipe#92); a phone the server cannot attest gets attestation_invalid there (ADR 0043, ADR 0087).

invitePhase.description: loading: GET /v1/me/invites of the account on screen runs. ready: available > 0. noneLeft: available is 0; the personal and company rows are off and the window shows BipeInviteQuota.noneLeft. failed: the quota did not load; the rows stay on and a tap tries again.

busy.description: true while POST /v1/me/invites runs after a tap. The rows are off.

error.description: bipe_error_network, bipe_error_rate_limited or bipe_error_invite_quota after a failed tap.

appear.effect: Reads GET /v1/me/invites with the token of the account on screen (BipeInviteCreator.quota). Creates nothing.

choosePersonal.effect: Runs BipeInviteCreator.createIfAvailable for the account on screen. created: opens signup-name with a SignupStart of type personal. noneLeft: sets invitePhase noneLeft.

chooseCompany.effect: The same as choosePersonal with a SignupStart of type company. signup-name then asks for bipe_company_name. The row names the account on screen with bipe_account_new_company_owner. When the sign-up finishes, the phone stores that account as the owner of the new company account (bipe-chat/bipe#444).

chooseExisting.effect: Opens recovery-start in the same sheet. A recovered account joins the phone as with account-start didRecover.

cancelSignup.effect: Closes the sign-up before signup-create and revokes the SignupStart invite (DELETE /v1/me/invites/{inviteId}), so the slot comes back. After signup-create started, the invite stays.

notes: Every new account needs an invite (ADR 0072). Here the invite comes from the quota of the account on screen; POST /v1/me/invites uses its token.
A sign-up from this window starts at signup-name. onboarding-welcome and signup-invite-code do not show. signup-invite-code shows only when signup-create gets invite_invalid (action fix).

A sign-up from this window has no inviter: signup-name does not show bipe_signup_invited_by, signup-done does not open a chat with the account on screen, and no inviter greeting is stored (ADR 0034, ADR 0138 rules 2 and 5).
The invite is made on the tap, never on appear, so opening and closing the window costs no invite.
A first sign-up on a phone with no account keeps onboarding-welcome and signup-invite-code (account-start noAccount).
Bipe logic: BipeInviteCreator and BipeInviteQuota (iOS BipeKit); myInvites, createInvite and revokeInvite in libraries/bipe BipeApiInvites (Android).
